His accent suggests he is in a part of the world where the standard household power system is 240 volts. A buck-converter (voltage reducing power supply) needs capacitors and inductors to do its job. These capacitors are actually rated too low for a 240 volt power supply, but that's a different concern altogether (product lifetime and early failure).
